factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for ocean whitefish.
factors.value_notes: The reviewed STRI species account and regional survey do not provide a numeric preferred SST or validated thermal response curve for ocean whitefish. The configured 13-22 °C range and 15-20 °C ideal remain unsupported by species-specific surface-temperature evidence; keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for ocean whitefish.
factors.value_notes: STRI reports ocean whitefish on rock and sand bottoms at 3-160 m, with observations around 80-160 m at Isla del Coco. This supports a demersal depth factor but shows the configured 10-100 m range and 12-95 m ideal do not represent the full species depth envelope; no single preferred interval is established.
